note: Hand-kept register of reported activity that a reporter lane does not match by title: unnamed activity, or a report that names tracked operations only in its text (decision 2, Tom, 16 Nov 2026; several tracked operations, alignment and activity_period from 16 Nov 2026). Rows are promoted by Tom from the private triage list (python tools/undertow.py triage, data/triage.jsonl, never published). Each row is the operation as the reporter frames it, never a person's name, handle, URL or domain of the operation. See undertow/activity.py for the fields and doctrine/method.md for the rules.

fields.operation: the operation's label as the reporter frames it (no names of individuals)
fields.label_starts_with_name: optional true when the label begins with a name or demonym, so it keeps its capital mid-sentence
fields.tracked_operations: optional list: ids in config/operations.json of the tracked operations the report names (Tom, 16 Nov 2026); the older single tracked_operation still reads

reporter.name: the reporter
reporter.terms: the reporter's terms, read and dated

first_report.url: the reporter's own page, on a host in reporter_hosts

fields.countries: ISO alpha-2 codes of the countries targeted, as the reporter states them
fields.activity_period: optional {from, to}, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD: the period the report says the activity ran (not the report date)
fields.origin: optional ISO alpha-2 codes of the origin the reporter states
fields.origin_evidence: own (the reporter shows its own evidence), cites-other (repeats a platform's or government's attribution) or none
fields.attribution_wording: optional: the reporter's attribution words, short
fields.alignment: optional ISO alpha-2 codes where the reporter calls the activity aligned with a state ('state-aligned', 'Kremlin-aligned'): recorded as alignment, never origin
fields.checked_by: who checked the row against the report (decision 4: origin counts only when this is set and origin_evidence is own)
fields.closed_into: optional: the disclosure key when a platform or government later names the network
